methodology: First-party reproduction re-run during the write stage on 2026-10-08: the public repository was cloned into a private per-run scratch directory, checked out at the commit recorded by the research stage, and the shipped commands were re-executed with the package's src directory on PYTHONPATH. Each entry's stdout and exit code below were captured verbatim from that run. Two short probe transcripts constructed for this review are included inline with their SHA-256. Outputs were diffed against the research-stage capture: identical apart from the exit code, which this record stores in its own field. This is a reproduction of the repository's own shipped fixture plus constructed inputs - not a production transcript. Absolute scratch paths in the command lines below are shown as $TMPDIR, the per-run private scratch directory supplied by the harness.
